column2: On the first day, Professor Lin handed out a syllabus listing every reading and exam date.
column3: 第一天，林教授發下一份教學大綱，列出每次的閱讀與考試日期。
column4: read the course syllabus (閱讀課程大綱)
column5: syllabus 像 sill-a-bus：坐上課程這輛巴士，一站站照大綱走

column2: The university redesigned its science curriculum so that every student studies both biology and data analysis.
column3: 大學重新設計理科課程，讓每位學生都學生物與資料分析。
column4: revise the curriculum (修訂課程規劃)
column5: cur 像「可」＋ riculum：一整套「可」修的課，全部課程

column2: Calculus is a prerequisite for the physics course, so you must pass it first.
column3: 微積分是這門物理課的先修科目，所以你必須先修過。
column4: meet the prerequisites (符合先修條件)
column5: pre 先 + requisite 需要：要先具備才能進下一關

column2: The registrar confirmed that her enrollment had been processed and her student ID was ready.
column3: 教務註冊主任確認她的註冊已辦妥，學生證也準備好了。
column4: visit the registrar's office (到註冊組辦公室)
column5: register 登記 → registrar 管登記的人

column2: Applicants must submit an official transcript showing every course they completed and the grades earned.
column3: 申請者必須繳交正式成績單，列出修過的每門課與所得成績。
column4: request an official transcript (申請正式成績單)
column5: trans 轉 + script 寫：把成績轉寫成一張紙

column2: Over five hundred freshmen filled the auditorium to hear the president's welcome speech.
column3: 五百多名新生擠滿禮堂，聆聽校長的歡迎演說。
column5: audi 聽：大家坐著聽的大廳，auditorium 就是禮堂

column2: During orientation, upperclassmen led the new students around campus and explained how to register for classes.
column3: 新生訓練期間，學長姐帶新生逛校園，並說明如何選課。
column4: attend orientation week (參加新生訓練週)
column5: orient 是東方；日出方向幫你找到方向，新生就靠它定位

column2: Graduate students presented early findings at a colloquium hosted by the linguistics department every Friday afternoon.
column3: 研究生在語言學系每週五下午舉辦的專題座談會上發表初步發現。
column4: host a colloquium (舉辦學術座談)
column5: col 一起 + loqu 說話：大家聚在一起說，就是座談

column2: Scholars from twelve countries gathered at the symposium to debate how climate change affects ancient farming.
column3: 來自十二國的學者聚集在研討會，辯論氣候變遷如何影響古代農耕。
column5: sym 一起 + posium 喝：古希臘人邊喝酒邊討論

column2: In the history seminar, twelve students took turns leading discussions about primary sources.
column3: 在歷史研討課上，十二名學生輪流帶領討論原始資料。
column5: seminar 裡 seed 像種子：小班討論讓想法發芽

column2: After six years of research, Maria finally defended her dissertation on migration patterns of sea turtles.
column3: 歷經六年研究，瑪麗亞終於通過她關於海龜遷徙模式的博士論文口試。
column4: defend a dissertation (口試博士論文)
column5: dis 分開 + sert 排列：把研究一項項排開寫成一本大書

column2: Her master's thesis argues that urban gardens strengthen neighborhood ties more than public parks do.
column3: 她的碩士論文主張，都市菜園比公園更能強化鄰里關係。
column5: thesis 開頭 th 像 the：要有「the」一個主張，整篇都在證明它

column2: After seven years of teaching and research, the young professor was granted tenure and could not easily be dismissed.
column3: 教了七年書並做研究後，這位年輕教授獲得終身教職，不能輕易被解聘。
column5: ten 像 ten 十年：教滿多年才拿到的鐵飯碗

column2: The engineering faculty voted to add a required ethics course for all graduating students.
column3: 工學院全體教師投票通過，為所有畢業生增設一門必修的倫理課。
column4: join the faculty (加入教師團隊)
column5: faculty 像「法克提」：一群老師組成的團隊

column2: Dr. Evans spent her sabbatical in Peru, collecting field notes for a book about mountain villages.
column3: 埃文斯博士利用學術休假前往秘魯，為一本關於山村的書蒐集田野筆記。
column5: sabbath 安息日：每七年休息一年，專心做研究

column2: Tuition at private universities has risen so fast that many families rely on loans to pay it.
column3: 私立大學學費上漲太快，許多家庭得靠貸款來支付。
column5: tuition 像「too-ish-un」：太貴(too)的那筆學費

column2: The graduate school offers a monthly stipend so that doctoral students can focus on research instead of part-time jobs.
column3: 研究所提供每月生活津貼，讓博士生能專心做研究而不必打工。
column5: stipend 像「是的拼」：每月領小錢，專心拼研究

column2: She won a fellowship that covered her research costs for two years at a leading laboratory.
column3: 她獲得一筆研究獎學金，支付她在頂尖實驗室兩年的研究費用。
column4: win a fellowship (獲得研究獎助)
column5: fellow 夥伴 + ship 身分：成為學術夥伴的資格

column2: First-year students are guaranteed a room in the dormitory, where they share a kitchen with five roommates.
column3: 大一新生保證能住進學生宿舍，並與五位室友共用廚房。
column5: dorm 像「多」姆：好多人睡覺的大房子

column2: Wealthy alumni donated enough money to build a new science library on their old campus.
column3: 富有的校友捐出足夠的錢，在母校校園蓋一座新的科學圖書館。
column5: alumni 像「阿拉你」：阿拉，你也是校友！

column2: At commencement, graduates in black gowns walked across the stage to receive their diplomas.
column3: 畢業典禮上，身穿黑袍的畢業生走過舞台領取畢業證書。
column5: commence 開始：畢業其實是人生新的開始

column2: The nursing program lost its accreditation after inspectors found that it no longer met national standards.
column3: 護理學程在檢查人員發現其不再符合國家標準後，失去了評鑑認證。
column5: ac 朝向 + credit 信任：讓人信任學校的認證

column2: Modern pedagogy emphasizes active discussion rather than silent memorization of facts.
column3: 現代教學法強調積極討論，而不是默默背誦事實。
column5: ped 孩子（如 pediatric 小兒科）+ agogy 引導：引導孩子學習的方法

column2: Students lost interest in the lecture because the speaker's didactic tone made every point sound like a lesson.
column3: 講者說教式的語氣把每個論點都講成訓誡，學生因此對演講失去興趣。
column5: did 像 die（發音「大」）：一直「大」道理說教很煩

column2: Students who matriculate in the fall must pay their fees before the first day of class.
column3: 秋季註冊入學的學生必須在開學第一天前繳費。
column4: matriculate at a university (註冊進入大學)
column5: matri 名冊：名字寫進名冊，就是正式入學

column2: Climate research is interdisciplinary, drawing on physics, chemistry, economics, and even psychology.
column3: 氣候研究是跨學科的，會運用物理、化學、經濟學，甚至心理學。
column5: inter 之間 + discipline 學科：橫跨好幾個學科之間
column7: in - ter - dis - ci - plin - ar - y

column2: The professor failed the student for plagiarism after discovering whole paragraphs copied from an online article.
column3: 教授發現學生整段抄自網路文章，以抄襲為由讓他不及格。
column5: plagiarism 像「噴雷」：抄別人的會「雷」到自己

column2: Each citation in the paper tells readers exactly where the original data came from.
column3: 論文中的每條引用都清楚告訴讀者原始資料出自何處。
column5: cite 引用 → citation 就是被引用的那一筆來源

column2: At the end of the report, a bibliography lists all the books and articles the author consulted.
column3: 報告最後的參考書目列出作者查閱過的所有書籍與文章。
column4: compile a bibliography (編製參考書目)
column5: biblio 書 + graphy 寫：把書名一本本寫下來

column2: The museum keeps its oldest letters in a climate-controlled archive and will archive new documents every month.
column3: 博物館把最古老的信件放在恆溫檔案庫中，而且每個月都會將新文件歸檔保存。
column5: archive 像「愛看夫」：愛看老文件的地方

column2: Before digital scanning, librarians stored old newspapers on microfiche, tiny sheets that had to be read with a viewer.
column3: 數位掃描出現之前，圖書館員把舊報紙存在縮微膠片上，得用閱讀機才看得到。
column5: micro 微小 + fiche 卡片：微小的卡片

column2: Her monograph on Roman roads, published by a university press, became the standard reference on the subject.
column3: 她那本關於羅馬道路的專題著作由大學出版社出版，成為此主題的標準參考書。
column4: publish a monograph (出版專題論著)
column5: mono 單一 + graph 寫：只寫一個主題的書

column2: The library subscribes to hundreds of periodicals, from monthly science magazines to quarterly journals.
column3: 圖書館訂閱數百種期刊，從月刊科學雜誌到季刊學術期刊都有。
column5: period 週期 + ical：每隔一段週期就出版

column2: The poetry anthology collects works by thirty writers from the nineteenth century.
column3: 這本詩選集收錄了十九世紀三十位作家的作品。
column5: anth 花 + ology：像把一朵朵花摘成一束，選集就是精選作品

column2: The compendium summarizes the entire field of marine biology in a single, concise volume.
column3: 這本綱要手冊把整個海洋生物學領域濃縮在簡明的一冊中。
column4: a compendium of facts (事實彙編)
column5: com 一起 + pend 掛：把重點全掛在一本小冊子裡

column2: Locke's famous treatise on government shaped political thinking in Europe and North America for generations.
column3: 洛克那篇著名的政府論專著影響歐洲與北美的政治思想達數個世代。
column5: treat 處理：認真處理一個主題的長篇專論

column2: Public discourse on artificial intelligence has shifted from excitement to careful debate about ethics.
column3: 關於人工智慧的公共論述，已從興奮轉為對倫理的審慎辯論。
column5: dis 分開 + course 跑：話題四處跑開，就是論述

column2: During her summer internship at a hospital, Kim learned how nurses organize patient records.
column3: 金在醫院的暑期實習中，學到護理師如何整理病患紀錄。
column5: intern 實習生 + ship 身分：當實習生的那段期間

column2: A senior engineer agreed to mentor the new graduates and teach them how to solve real problems.
column3: 一位資深工程師同意指導新進畢業生，教他們如何解決實際問題。
column5: mentor 像「門頭」：站在門口給你指路的人

column2: The famous painter proudly introduced his protege, a teenager who had already won two national art prizes.
column3: 這位著名畫家驕傲地介紹他的門生，一位已經拿過兩次全國美術獎的少年。
column4: a talented protege (有才華的門生)
column5: protege 像「普羅特傑」：被保護(protect)的得意弟子
